summary: feat(settings): adopt Nova semantics in Settings
description:
Because:
- Settings components set colors with raw utilities and hand-written dark: pairs.
- Nova restyles Switch, Checkbox and AlertBar with accent and status tokens.

This commit:
- Swaps exact light/dark pairs for semantic utilities across Settings.
- Collapses other neutral pairs onto semantic tokens under nova: only.
- Makes Switch on, Checkbox checked and the avatar slider accent under nova:.
- Moves inline blue focus outlines to outline-focus; drops dead grey classes.
- Adds nova:-only text-accent-primary and bg-overlay; records gaps in README.
